_: french-ids.json — the number in each French card's id, pinned to its note: <deck id> → <headword> (the Word field; a sounds-deck row's key) → N, for the id u_<deck id>_N. Seeded from the decks as shipped on 2026-11-16 by french-fix.js --seed-ids, before anything moved. Never delete or renumber a row: the Update press merges a reader's progress by card id. A note the record removes moves to _retired; a rename renames the key. DELF A1 (highest 446 for 433 notes) and B2 (1,654 for 1,653) had notes folded away by paradigm-fix.js before this file existed; those numbers have no row and are never dealt again, a new note taking a number above the highest.
